Hi Samira / team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a consolidated draft of Exhibit E (capacity schedules + billing tiers) and a redline-friendly order-form draft for the upcoming renewal and capacity uplift. We want to lock sequencing before legal starts final redlines so there are no surprises for procurement.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm which billing tier Novus will move to on the renewal effective date (Dec 1)? The attached draft assumes Tier 3 for months 1–12, then Tier 4 after the first anniversary.
- Are there internal approvals required from your Procurement or Finance teams before we start exchanging signed paperwork? If yes, please share the point of contact and expected lead time.

Internal: looping in Karthik and Laura to own legal/ops coordination. Markus — please confirm the Exhibit E section numbering matches our canonical template so downstream docs align.

Attachments: Novus_ExhibitE_v3.pdf (PDF, 220KB); RI_OrderForm_Novus_Dec2026_draft.docx (Word, 150KB).

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu

[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the files — appreciate the tidy consolidation. A few clarifications from our side before we bring this to Procurement: 

1) Billing tier: we expect to target Tier 4 effective on renewal (we are accelerating usage). Can you produce a clean order-form that reflects Tier 4 start date on 2026-12-01 and shows the ramp schedule?
2) Procurement loop: yes — cc'd ProcureOps (managed by Elena). They typically need 7–10 business days to review commercial terms and 10–15 for legal redlines. If we compress, we can aim for a two-week turn but will need a final draft.
3) One more ask: for the SLA credits table in Exhibit C, can you confirm whether the credit cap changes with the tier bump? Our legal has flagged that as a condition.

We can schedule a short call with Procurement if that will speed things up.

Best,
